_meta.purpose: Permanent record of which destinations' real-world hero photos have been visually inspected (not just text-audited) during the ongoing photo-mismatch review, so repeat passes sample destinations that haven't been looked at yet instead of re-covering the same ground.
_meta.note_on_passes_1_10: Passes 1-10 (2026-10-20 to 2026-10-22, documented in CLAUDE.md's 'Real-world photo mismatch pass' section) did not log individual destination ids as they went -- only aggregate counts and the specific destinations where a real mismatch was found and fixed. Those confirmed fixes are seeded below under pass 1-10 with reviewed: true. The destinations that were sampled and found CLEAN in passes 6-10's visual batches (roughly 120 photos total) were never individually recorded and cannot be reconstructed, so they are not listed here -- pass 11 onward logs every destination reviewed, clean or not.
_meta.schema: reviewed[destId] = { pass, date, method: 'visual'|'text', result: 'clean'|'fixed', note? }
